TA REMAINDER LOCK v036: Realistic illustrated cinematic desert-colony caper; dimensional natural faces and material detail, not Disney or photoreal live action. Approved direct character references govern identity; Harper retains her established short hair and outfit; Taffy is portly with full cheeks and large rounded ears. Humanoid hands have four fingers plus one thumb and natural wrists. Scrapper is kind beaked ant alien with four arms, two bare clawed legs, metallic-knit sleeveless top, separate teal wrap and canvas powered-tool belt. Private guards wear cream uniforms and cobalt armor. Ship is the approved broad ivory/teal Harrier motorhome, stubby wings, one fin, four side vector nozzles, fixed recessed forward nose radar and missing machinery covers. No external radar dish or pre-Harrier twin engine pods. Clean landscape16:9 single starter frame, no titles, borders, rulers, readable Earth text or montage. Depict the setup just before action; all necessary visible participants and props already present, no duplicated characters or future outcomes prematurely enacted. END LOCK.
Use case: illustration-story. Only Harper and Taffy. Low medium threequarter interior at port workbench. Taffy kneels steady beside open cabinet, holding loose securing strap ready to cinch around small squat teal substitute module with TWO copper collars and dogleg adapter already installed in cradle. Harper stands behind glancing between blocked departure view at window and a ridiculous salvaged faded floral seat cushion she has set aside, wry disappointment at abandoned comforts. Both motivated, no smile at camera. Small module approximately22cm, not giant appliance. Powered cabin lamps on. Start before strap tightening; no original ivory cartridge. Bench geometry comes from cabinref.
Final reference is exact installation geometry authority; keep module same size as shown there, horizontal U bracket tray, right-angle adapter now CONNECTED securely inside cabinet rather than held. Crushed original remains on lower linkage. Change actor poses: Taffy cinching strap, Harper standing with cushion, camera wider from doorway.
CRITICAL geography: Camera looking forward from aft. Workbench and module MUST be on LEFT of picture, pilot seats ahead in background, starboard entry on RIGHT. Dark salvage clutter right outside windows, NOT open sky/desert/city. Match S10SH04 installation on LEFT exactly, adapter connected leftward into existing bench. Taffy LEFT kneeling facing left toward cabinet, Harper RIGHT standing holding cushion. No mirroring cabin.

qa.notes: Second attempt corrected mirrored bench geography. Bench LEFT looking forward, hatch RIGHT, connected substitute and crushed original below, loose strap for cinching. Module relative scale follows S10 anchor, not centimeter measurement.
qa.starterIntent: Setup before primary shot action; preserve forward motion in video direction.
